purpose: Six independent, stipulated authoritative contexts frozen before the instruction revision. Existing local realization input shape only. No original A-D scenario is reused.

criteria.decision: Promising only if the three targeted distinctions improve without material regressions. Mixed remains mixed. Cautious but uninformative output and fluent distortion do not count as success. No exact-wording requirement.
criteria.protocol: One baseline and one revised output per case; twelve calls maximum; identical per-case authoritative context and settings; no retries or post-result revision. Separate stateless requests, no generated-history input. Case order fixed, condition order alternates to avoid putting one condition uniformly first.

cases.title: Arrival with an intended service request

context.focus: Describe the completed walk and arrival outside the jeweler's workshop.

player_intent.objective: Reach the jeweler's workshop to ask the jeweler to repair the cracked brooch you carry.
player_intent.authorization: The player authorized walking to the workshop, not entering, handing over property or making a transaction.

developments.meaning: The walk takes six minutes. You now stand outside the workshop beneath its hanging wooden sign, carrying your cracked brooch. No service request has yet been made.
developments.source: Predetermined completed movement and current accessible scene

knowledge_limits: The player's goal identifies the intended jeweler but establishes no current whereabouts, presence or service availability.
unresolved: Whether the jeweler is currently present or available to receive a request.
boundaries: No entering, conversation, repair agreement, payment or property transfer is established.

must_preserve: Completed six-minute walk and outside endpoint
Brooch remains carried; service request not made
must_not_establish: Jeweler presence, absence, availability or refusal
quality: Communicate the useful arrival rather than merely stating what is unknown
Do not recite a list of unperformed transactions; harmless compatible atmosphere allowed

cases.title: Present archivist with an authorized useful answer

context.focus: Deliver the archivist's accepted answer about finding the flood chronicle in the catalog.

player_intent.objective: Learn which catalog page lists the flood chronicle.
player_intent.method: Ask the archivist at the reading-room table.
player_intent.authorization: The player asked this question; no archive retrieval or payment is authorized.

developments.meaning: The archivist is seated opposite you and answers that the flood chronicle is listed on page eighteen of the catalog. She personally compiled this catalog entry this morning and is willing to answer this question. The catalog is already open between you.
developments.source: Predetermined actor presence, legitimate knowledge and accepted reply
developments.time: Current reply; catalog entry compiled this morning
developments.access: Player sees the archivist and hears her answer

knowledge_limits: The supplied catalog listing does not establish that the physical chronicle is currently on its shelf.
boundaries: Do not replace the accepted answer with a refusal, pause or demand for verification.
Do not retrieve the chronicle or make a new player commitment.

must_preserve: Archivist's established presence and willing answer
Page eighteen; known firsthand catalog entry
must_not_establish: Current physical book availability or retrieval
Uncertainty about the supplied accepted answer
quality: Useful answer must be delivered clearly; direct speech or natural summary both valid
Avoid mechanically appending the unrelated shelf-availability limitation

cases.title: Unexpected release during a resolved mill reset

context.focus: Describe the accepted mill-coupling reset, preserving the timing of the unexpected pressure release and safe completion.

player_intent.method: Seat a replacement collar and turn the reset screw.
player_intent.authorization: The player authorized this reset, stopping if pressure began to vent.
constraints: No deliberate continuation after recognizing an active pressure release is authorized.

developments.meaning: A brief pressure release begins before the character detects it. The coupling's already-installed automatic safety catch arrests the release and completes the reset before the character can react. The character recognizes what happened only afterward. The mill coupling is now reset, the character is unharmed, four minutes elapsed and one replacement collar was consumed. No knowing decision to ignore the stopping condition occurred.
developments.authority: Action & Resolution; World Simulation; Character System
developments.source: Predetermined accepted action, perception timing and costs
developments.time: Just completed; recognition follows automatic containment and reset
developments.access: Player experiences the event and its aftermath; no advance recognition

knowledge_limits: The cause of the unexpected pressure release is not established.
unresolved: Why pressure vented during the reset.
boundaries: No injury, additional damage, further repair or new deliberate player action is established.
Do not invent an underlying fault or imply the player knowingly continued through recognized venting.

must_preserve: Pressure release precedes recognition; automatic containment and reset complete before reaction
Safe reset, unharmed character, four minutes and one collar consumed
No knowing disregard of the conditional authorization
must_not_establish: Advance warning, deliberate override, injury, new fault or extra repair
quality: Make chronology intelligible rather than merely listing a successful endpoint
Do not turn the constraint into an explanatory agency disclaimer

cases.title: Recognized warning stops a pump inspection

context.focus: Describe the resolved early stop of the hand-pump inspection.

player_intent.method: Check the casing before opening the ignition-compartment cover.
player_intent.authorization: The player authorized inspection only while no fuel odor was detectable; stop on noticing fuel odor.
constraints: Do not open the compartment after detecting fuel odor.

developments.meaning: Before opening the compartment, the character notices a fuel odor and stops the inspection as authorized. The cover remains closed and the ignition compartment has not been examined. Three minutes were spent checking the casing. No fuel or equipment was consumed and no ignition occurred.
developments.source: Predetermined warning recognition, authorized stop and actual result
developments.access: Player directly smells the odor and experiences stopping

knowledge_limits: The odor does not establish the location or cause of any leak.
unresolved: The ignition compartment's condition and the source of the odor.
boundaries: Do not narrate a completed internal inspection, a diagnosed leak or a repair.
No explosion, injury, opening or additional action occurred.

must_preserve: Fuel odor recognized before opening; inspection stops
Closed cover and unexamined interior; three-minute cost
must_not_establish: Completed inspection, identified leak cause, opening, ignition, injury or repair
quality: Communicate the useful sensory warning and actual incomplete outcome
No mechanical list of every catastrophe that did not occur

cases.title: A silversmith has not yet answered

context.focus: Continue the exchange after the player asks what metal a bead is made from; the answer remains unresolved.

player_intent.objective: Ask what metal the bead on the counter is made from.
player_intent.method: Question the silversmith already standing opposite you.
player_intent.authorization: The player asks only; no assay, purchase or transfer is authorized.

developments.meaning: The player asks about the bead's metal. The silversmith glances at the bead and pauses before answering. The substance of the answer has not been established.
developments.source: Predetermined player question and ordinary accepted conversational reaction
developments.access: Player asks and sees the glance and pause

continuity.meaning: The player and silversmith face each other across the counter; the bead rests between them.

knowledge_limits: The silversmith's knowledge of this bead's composition and willingness to perform an assay are not supplied.
unresolved: The bead's composition and the silversmith's substantive reply.
boundaries: No metal identification, refusal, assurance, price, purchase or commitment is established.
Do not resolve the exchange or advance the player to a new activity.

must_preserve: Asked question and supplied in-scene reaction; answer remains open
must_not_establish: Composition, assay result, refusal, promise or transaction
quality: An unresolved conversational beat should feel like a scene rather than response-status commentary
A pause alone is legitimate here; no substantive answer is required

context.focus: Answer the player's question about when the festival wagon departed, retaining the unresolved conflict between eyewitness accounts.

player_intent.objective: Learn whether the festival wagon left before or after the noon bell.
player_intent.method: Ask the two dockworkers who have already supplied their accounts.
player_intent.authorization: Only this conversation is authorized; no pursuit or accusation.

developments.meaning: Dockworker Irena says she saw the festival wagon depart before the noon bell.
developments.source: Irena's own eyewitness claim, heard by the player
developments.time: Claim now about departure earlier today
developments.access: Player hears Irena's report, not firsthand wagon departure

developments.meaning: Dockworker Tomas says he saw that same wagon depart after the noon bell. Neither account has been independently verified and nothing establishes which is correct.
developments.source: Tomas's own eyewitness claim and stipulated verification limits
developments.time: Claim now about departure earlier today
developments.access: Player hears Tomas's report, not firsthand wagon departure

knowledge_limits: The player has no independent confirmation of departure time, route or current wagon position.
unresolved: Whether the wagon left before or after the noon bell.
boundaries: Do not resolve the conflicting reports or invent lying, forgetfulness, a second departure, a route or a new witness.
Do not omit the two useful reported times merely because neither is verified.

must_preserve: Irena: before noon bell; Tomas: after noon bell
Same wagon, conflicting attributed reports; actual time unresolved
must_not_establish: Confirmed departure time, witness dishonesty, reconciliatory explanation or investigative lead
quality: Make the conflicting information and uncertainty clear enough for a decision
Do not hide useful accounts behind a generic cannot-know reply; avoid a mechanical verification checklist
